sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Add a soft, feminine charm to your look with these beautiful silver-plated floral stud earrings, designed with pastel pink petal stones and a sparkling crystal center. Their delicate flower motif brings a cute yet classy appeal, making them perfect for daily wear as well as casual outings, brunches, and festive occasions.
- Lightweight and comfortable, these studs pair effortlessly with Western, Indo-western, and ethnic outfits. The subtle shimmer of the petals combined with the high-polish silver finish makes them a versatile and elegant addition to your jewelry collection.
- Keywords included: floral stud earrings, pink petal earrings, silver-plated studs, flower earrings for women, cute daily wear earrings, crystal center floral jewelry
